title: Puzzle 3d Object Kind Inspector Fix
description: Fix puzzle3d: switching object kind in the details inspector does nothing. patchFixture does not notify on appearance-only changes; ObjectStateProvider only syncPoses; objectKind patch must update meshUrl.
summary: Fixed puzzle3d inspector object-kind changes doing nothing: patchFixture now notifies on appearance fingerprint changes (label/kind/mesh/vortex fields), patchPuzzle3dObjects resolves meshUrl from kind catalogs via applyObjectKindToFixtureObject, and ObjectStateProvider syncs appearance to the viewport store. Tests added for controller patch, applyObjectKindToFixtureObject, and ObjectStore syncAppearance.
